page: Microsoft Azure EC48ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the instance includes 1843 GB of local disk capacity and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard graphics processing units associated with this configuration.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server represents a memory-optimized hardware profile. The inclusion of dedicated AMD cores and a substantial local storage allocation makes it suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, and enterprise applications requiring high resource density without the overhead of GPU acceleration.
